subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spill the beans

options.text: Behave or speak in a rash manner
To reveal a secret information unintentionally

solution: The correct answer is: **To reveal a secret information unintentionally**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"spill the beans"** means to reveal secret information unintentionally. (गुप्त जानकारी का अनजाने में खुलासा करना) • **Example: **John accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party during lunch. Therefore, the correct answer is: ***To reveal a secret information unintentionally***. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Excellent health **(बेहतर स्वास्थ्य): Being in a state of good physical and mental well-being. • **Example:** She is in excellent health after her recent recovery. • **Behave or speak in a rash manner **(बेबुनियादी तरीके से व्यवहार या बात करना): Acting or speaking without thinking carefully. • **Example: **He tends to behave in a rash manner when he's upset. • **Things always get worse **(चीजें हमेशा खराब होती जाती हैं): A pessimistic view that situations will continuously deteriorate. • **Example:** He believes that things always get worse before they get better. 42:Taa4, The correct answer is: **process**.
